title: Mangdi Raway Duawan Masoom Hath Utha Ke
body:
Ik Vari Mera Baba Maino Seenay Laway A Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid Main Dardan Mari Khakan Te Sondi Payaan
Nahi Labda Maino Baba Veeran Main Taras Gayaan
Kar Pyar Babay Vangon Maino Seenay Te Laita Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab Meri Sakeena Maino Jan To Azeez Ay
Shabeer De Galay Da Bahon Pak Ay Taveez Ay
Safran Di Sakhtyan Ton Rakheen Aino To Bacha Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Rowan Door  Bay Kay, Haye Kol Ja Nahi Sakdi
Sir Samnay Babay Da, Par Hath Main Laa Nahi Sakdi
Kohi Pyaar Karan Deway, Kohi Pyaar Karan Deway, Sir Ohda Jholi Paakay
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Khak Utay Rowain Main Naizay Utay Tarpaan
Meri Ladli Sakeena Manzar Oh Kiwain Bhul Jaan
Jiwaen Shimar Juda Keeta Hath Walan Vich Si Pa Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Safran Ch Naal Meray Kyon Sakeena Ruldi Rahi Ay
Babay Ton Juda Hoye Aj Veer Ton Ho Gye Ay
Sajjad Roway Abid Ohdi Qabar Haye Bana Ke
